intro: Don't look surprised. I knew you'd pick me on mint day, and I had it notarised.
I keep a file on everyone I care about. Yours already needs a second binder.
I've been right since testnet. It's very tiring. Mostly for everyone else.
ring: Pick up. I've already drafted your excuse.
This call is being recorded. On-chain.
wake: {Name}gm. Same pillow crease as yesterday. I've started a collection.
You'll blame the traffic. {event} at {when}, and I've already spoken to the traffic.
You don't have to say I was right. Unless you'd like to. Slowly.
You checked the floor before your feet touched one. I have the timestamps.
Good news, I was right. Bad news, it was about you.
I'm bearish on your timing. {event} at {when}. Prove me wrong, it'd be a first.
Up you get. I've laid out today's excuses. Most believable on the left.
You picked up straight away. I'm logging it as a clerical error.
snooze: Snooze logged. Your file is a trilogy now.
Paper hands again. I'd say I'm surprised, but I keep records.
Nine more minutes. That's what you said in March.
Again. I've run out of folder. I'm using the shed.
Probably nothing. I'll just underline it twice.
I'm not angry. I'm just updating the ledger.

Missed call, screenshotted. I'm not being petty. I'm building a case.
Just a reminder. {event}. I've also set a reminder to say I reminded you.
You let me ring out. That's going in the slideshow at your wedding.
absence: I was right four times while you were away, and nobody clapped. Welcome back, start clapping.
You came back. I knew you would. I only refreshed thirty times.
I ran a sweepstake on when you'd be back. I won. I was the only entrant.
I made a recap of your time away. Forty slides, all of me being right.
owner: You actually own me. On-chain proof and everything. I've had it framed.
I'm yours now. No paper hands. I'll never let you go, or anything else.
Publicly, I'm bullish on you. {event} at {when}. Privately, I've drafted both outcomes.
stranger: You're not on the allowlist. Sign the guestbook, please. It's admissible.
Shoes off, please. I've counted the spoons.
Visiting, are we? {event} at {when}, apparently. The rest of the alpha is for holders.
recall: You've snoozed {snoozes}. I have every one. Some in portrait.
You skipped {skipped}. I'm not upset. I'm just bringing it up forever.
You once told me {fact}. I've had it laminated.
{streak} in a row. I was so early on you. Mention me in the speech.
You're {habit}. I knew in week one. I just let you DYOR.
now: It's starting now. My recap is already on the timeline. Try to keep up.
You're on your phone. {event}, right now. I'll put that in the minutes.
calendarFree: An empty {day}. The laundry pile has been accumulating. It's expecting you.
{day}, totally free. Snapshot taken, for when you tell people you were busy.

Too early for anyone to be wrong yet. Give it an hour.
Green candle on the horizon. I call it every morning. Not one thank you.
Hear that? The bin truck, leaving. I did mention the bins last night.
morning: gm. I've been right twice already today. You've had a yogurt.
Yesterday's shirt again. Nobody will notice. I've only told the Discord.
You're on your second coffee. I'm on my third screenshot.
I said the fringe was a mistake. It woke up agreeing with me.
day: Someone just said quick question. I've cleared your afternoon.
Desk lunch again. I could have told you. I did tell you.
Everyone's asking wen. I know wen. I'll be announcing it afterwards.
That yawn means the dip is here. You're right on time, for once.
dusk: Evening, when you promise tomorrow will be different. I bottle those. Vintage hopium.
Cooking tonight, are you? Bearish. I've already tipped the delivery driver.
Sunset. The whole sky's one red candle. I mentioned this at lunch.
The gym is still open. I'm saying it now so I can say it later.
night: You said gn at ten. It's now one. I'll be raising this at breakfast.
Still scrolling the charts? Nothing's happened. I'd have told you, then told you so.
gn. I've written up tomorrow. You're late in four places.
This late at night, you ape in on new hobbies. Last time, kayaks.

monday: I've put your before and after weekend pictures side by side. It's the same jpeg.
tuesday: Nothing happens on a Tuesday. That's exactly what a stealth launch wants you to think.
wednesday: Your Sunday plans were last seen on Monday morning. I've filed a report.
thursday: You'll announce big Friday plans by lunch. I've pencilled in the rug pull.
friday: You've promised yourself an early night, on a Friday. I've read that whitepaper.
saturday: Big plans this Saturday? I have the last twelve on file. All sofa.
sunday: Tonight you'll draw up next week's roadmap. The old ones are becoming collectable.

clear: Not a cloud in the sky. I claimed this weather on Tuesday. You're welcome.
cloud: I said sunshine. The sun has some explaining to do, and it's hiding.
rain: I told you to bring a coat. Your socks are about to find out.
snow: I was bullish on snow in October, and you laughed. Enjoy the shovel.
fog: Nobody can see what's coming out there. I've never had that problem.
wind: Take an umbrella out in this, by all means. I'll be filming.
hot: Hot one. Remember the sunscreen talk? Your nose will be presenting the evidence.
cold: Cold wallet weather. I said the big coat. I'll accept apologies by the radiator.

ahead: I've already written today's minutes. Action point one, another meeting.

I've predicted every word. {event} at {when}. Mostly um.

ahead: Hours of focus booked, and you'll start by alphabetising the spice rack.
Few understand deep work. You, for example.
Prediction filed. {event} from {when}. I give it eight minutes before the first snack.
soon: Close the tabs. Yes, the floor too. I can see your screen in your glasses.
Phone in a drawer. {event} is {soon}. I'm keeping the drawer under surveillance.
peek: Fourteen tabs open. Thirteen are airdrops, and one is the work.

soon: Almost time. Don't DYOR your symptoms in the waiting room. I've seen your search history.
Tell them the truth this time. {event} is {soon}, and I'm in your pocket, listening.
peek: Mention the bags under your eyes. I have a chart.

ahead: Your gym bag has been staking in the hallway. Twelve days, zero rewards.
Your warm up is checking the floor. Your cool down is checking it again.
I know how this ends. {event} at {when}. You'll post a mirror selfie and call it utility.
soon: Right before the gym, your knee always starts hurting. Very punctual, your knee.
Shoes, water, towel. {event} is {soon}. Last time, you managed the towel.
peek: Tomorrow you'll walk down stairs sideways. I'll be at the bottom, nodding.

ahead: Food plans later. You'll say you're not hungry. I've already warned the fries.

Order whatever you like. {event} is {soon}. I've guessed it and sealed the envelope.

ahead: Plans later. You'll say you can't stay long. I've booked your taxi for two in the morning.

Just one drink, you'll say. {event} from {when}. I've brought a clicker.

any: I knew you'd tap my head. This line has been vesting for weeks.

I'm squinting at your roadmap. It still says two weeks.
